delivery.title: More than recruitment. Industrial workforce delivery.
delivery.description: We support industrial companies throughout the workforce process — from understanding technical requirements to selecting, preparing and supporting qualified professionals for the project.

steps.title: PROJECT REQUIREMENTS
steps.description: We understand the technical profiles, project location, schedule, duration and workforce requirements.

steps.title: TECHNICAL SELECTION
steps.description: We identify professionals whose experience, qualifications and technical skills match the project requirements.

steps.title: DOCUMENTATION
steps.description: We organize and verify the documentation required for each professional and project.

steps.title: WORKFORCE PREPARATION
steps.description: Selected professionals receive the project information and preparation required before deployment.

steps.title: MOBILITY & LOGISTICS
steps.description: When required, we support travel, accommodation and workforce logistics according to project conditions.

steps.title: PROJECT FOLLOW-UP
steps.description: Our team maintains operational communication and workforce follow-up throughout the assignment.
